we developed a new, easyto- use, open-source, cross-platform, physics and graphics engine simulator that enables designers and developers of autonomous vehicles to seamlessly generate training data for machine learned models.

enabling the design of autonomous vehicles by making it easy to collect training data and to test the performance of the system.

enabling the use of machine learning techniques for autonomous robotic systems by providing a realistic, fast physics engine and a cross-platform, open-source, extensible architecture that is capable of generating vast quantities of training data.
the design, development and evaluation of a new simulation framework that enables fast, realistic simulation of autonomous robotic vehicles.
